jobs.title: Seasonal Operations Associate (Part-Time) - Century City
jobs.description_text: OBJECTIVE The Seasonal Operations Associate supports store goals during peak and high-volume business periods by delivering exceptional guest experiences and bringing the ALO Brand Mission to life. JOB RESPONSIBILITIES Execute inventory management processes effectively with a focus om maximizing inventory accuracy & reducing shrink Investigate and root cause inventory accuracy issues, partnering with the General/Store Manager to escalate process or system gaps Support execution of key operational functions including shipment, receiving and processing, reverse transfers, sales floor recovery, intra-day sales floor replenishment, floor set updates, and supply management Maintain and champion strong visual standards for the sales floor Work closely with reporting, budgets, expenses, inventory control, supplies, vendor relationships, technology, and facilities to ensure maintained and maximized Support a safe work environment and efficient operation through strong stockroom standards and processes Move dynamically on the retail floor to assess and fulfill the needs of the business, team and guests Execute company-level operations-focused directives, projects and initiates, in partnership with the Operations & Visual Management team. jobs.title: Supply Planner
jobs.description_text: OVERVIEW The Supply Planner is responsible for in-season supply planning to ensure the right products are available at the right time to meet customer demand. This role translates demand forecasts into executable supply plans balancing cost, capacity, lead times, and vendor constraints in a fast-paced apparel environment The ideal candidate brings strong experience in supply or production planning, inventory optimization, and cross-functional collaboration. They will partner closely with Product Development, Merchandising, Buying, Raw Materials, Production, Logistics, and global vendor partners to deliver seasonal collections and replenishment programs on time. RESPONSIBILITIES Partner with Product Development, Production, Raw Materials, Buying, Merchandising, and Logistics teams to support the timely delivery of seasonal collections and replenishment programs. Translate unconstrained demand into actionable supply plans considering cost, capacity, lead times, MOQ, raw materials, and vendor constraints.
